notes.title: Zekus Forgate and Lilahammer Join Last Cloudia! ＆ 4.5 Year Anniversary Promotion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ab5441e53c8f3b904f19b3727bc7c08dc6791039.jpg[/img]
On October 12, post-maintenance, the Descent of Heroes Festival and the Step Up Descent of Heroes Festival will be released!

[b]New Unit[/b]
[b]Zekus Forgate (Voice: Ryota Osaka)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/63abda2289ce6d04182715288c100169250fd3c6.jpg[/img]

[b]New Ark[/b]
[b]Lilahammer (UR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/c8c1a4fba4bbc8b3d81ee2b9857b343ea566e12a.jpg[/img]

Ark Trait (Ark Lv 15)
All-enemy attack magic damage +30%.
Cut physical/ magic damage taken (max -40%; each wave, gradually cut effect).
When casting magic, boost the magic’s damage cap based on amonunt of MP used (max +6000 at 200+ MP used).
*Excludes magic that regularly deals damage.

[b]100% Ark Ether Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2dfce0f2b3516574d56ccc6953db9aa0fb6f1da5.png[/img]



[b]Daily Free 10-Spin Gacha Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/8b0569acba108a9a9fe133000895827fda9e14ea.jpg[/img]
This is a free 10-spin gacha that you can spin once per day!
Don’t forget to spin every day!

[Points]
• This is a free 10-spin gacha that you can spin once per day, for up to 250 times!
• Descent of Heroes Festival-limited units and UR arks are also in the draw pool for this gacha!
• Each time you spin the gacha, you’ll get 100 4.5 Year Anniv Medals, which can be exchanged for various items!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



[b]Event 4.5 Year Anniversary Festival Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/298e4dc04660bfb3e4d1f94887d08d9abf548026.jpg[/img]
This quest celebrates the 4.5 year anniversary of Last Cloudia.
If you clear it, you’ll get 3000 crystals, so don’t miss it!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



[b]4.5 Year Anniversary Special Gift[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/589037e28d9254fbeeab22c0a2788c01f846aa3b.png[/img]
The 4.5 Year Anniversary Special Gift will appear on the upper left of the Home screen!
Claim this gift to receive a ★4.5YearAnniv UR Ark Trade Ticket, which can be used to trade for a UR ark of your choice in the lineup.
Once you get it, use it in the 4.5 Year Anniversary UR Ark Trading Space!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



[b]Event Anniversary Match Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/84d2df49e0a3763e432cab2c5c5de8dc79fe02ef.jpg[/img]
In this event, you can play quests that help with training your units.
When you clear these quests, there’s a chance that bonus quests which support multiplayer will appear! Take them on to get various materials and ★Cadet Tickets to train your units!

For a limited time only during this event, certain Celebratory series equipment from past anniversary events will be able to be godforged and enhanced.
This will be the first redux for incredibly powerful equipment like Celebratory Ring and Celebratory Medal, so you won’t want to miss this chance!

[Event Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 25, 11:59 pm (PT)




[b]Collect 4.5 Year Anniv Medals![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/452fb206c2f4210a03866391029439207dd5c2a4.jpg[/img]
During the event, you’ll be able to get 4.5 Year Anniv Medals from various locations.
Amazing rewards like ★4.5 Year Anniv Gacha Tickets and Crystal Ultraclusters of each color have been added to the Trading Space lineup!
Collect lots of medals and exchange them for items!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Nov 8, 10:59 pm (PT)



[b]4.5 Year Anniversary Last Cloudia Popularity Poll Prelims Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/4d0abae6c21732181916925fc46856e569fbc574.jpg[/img]
The Last Cloudia Popularity Poll is split up into two rounds: prelims and finals. The prelims will begin on Oct 12, and the finals will begin on Oct 26.
The finals will include the ten most popular units from the prelims. The most popular unit from the finals will get a shift that will be released at a later date.

[Voting Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 22, 7:59 am (PT)



[b]4.5 Year Anniversary Login Bonus Pt. 1[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/192a1f75c4cd427b3303772d9092f8ce7b148755.png[/img]
A login bonus celebrating Last Cloudia’s 4.5 year anniversary will be released!
You can get a Luminous Soul (a rare item used for ◆7+ awakening) and ★4.5 Year Anniv Gacha Tickets, so you’ll definitely want to log in every day to get all of the magnificent items in this login bonus!



[b]New Story Added[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1d6c06833a8c4199ea3940451cdc4e155c5082cb.jpg[/img]
Log in daily for rare and useful gifts from this login bonus!

[Period]
Oct 12, post-maintenance – Oct 25, 11:59 pm (PT)




Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Team

notes.title: Divine Beast Thouzer and Thrall of God, Apropolika Join Last Cloudia!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/b8c2cd75b8094d075d4673fc4155020d3cb7cb3e.jpg[/img]
On July 13, 2023, post-maintenance, the Descent of Heroes Festival and the Step Up Descent of Heroes Festival will be released!

[Period]
July 13, post maintenance – Aug 9, 11:59 pm (PT)

New Unit
Divine Beast Thouzer (Voice: Yuuichirou Umehara)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/e5b86e6760b1de2bdc6d2b9ca8a2448ea72a0e92.jpg[/img]
New Ark
Thrall of God, Apropolika (UR)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/0335f30dc4dd5421cf295c659e1f148f62f36d5b.jpg[/img]
Ark Trait (Ark Lv 15)
HP +30%, but when far enough from enemy, magic attack damage taken +10%.
The first 10 seconds of battle, give STR/ INT -50% debuff to all enemies.
Dark attack damage +20%/ damage cap +2500.

100% Ark Ether Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1d064a7b11ac9886d4d0fb7650d6cab5c230ae88.png[/img]

Event An Executioner Bemused by Blood Released!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/8c95d379c5efc4a1c9bdcd46b9e7022934a9ee14.jpg[/img]
In this event, play quests to collect tickets that you can use to take on the Extra Challenge, which gives amazing rewards.
Clearing the Extra Challenge will reward you with high rarity godforge alchemy materials and enhancement materials, so don’t miss out on playing it!

Additionally, some equipment can be enhanced using alchemy for a limited time only during this event.
Don’t miss out!

▼Summary
In a time before Thouzer, the warden of Penal Island Pantorbane, had his chance encounter with a certain one-winged divine beast,
he has been granted the rank and power of a thrall of god by the Goddess. In order to test this power, he enters the depths of the island…

It is here, in the deepest depths of Penal Island Pantorbane,

that prisoners with powers beyond human control have been imprisoned,
since even before Thouzer became the warden.

[Period]
July 13, post-maintenance – July 26, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

New Story Added Notice
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6ee9d703b019ddc39681c1ea68fa34acacc7e6c7.jpg[/img]
Pass through the cloudfield to save Rei!

New story chapters will be added!
Enjoy the ever-expanding world of Last Cloudia!

 

Added Story Login Bonus Released

Log in daily to get training materials!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/49031c2b92013fa996622b5cc9599ac7e34f8c45.png[/img]

[Period]
July 13, post-maintenance – July 26, 11:59 pm (PT)

 
5 Million Worldwide Downloads Hero Pick-Up Stock Ticket Gacha
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/a9dd86e2c664f6c318c48bb8749d4b51b39f1c8a.jpg[/img]
On July 13, post-maintenance, the 5 Million Worldwide Downloads Hero Pick-Up Stock Ticket Gacha will be released!

[Period]
July 13, post-maintenance – July 26, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

notes.title: Heavenly Knight Melza and Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice Join Last Cloudia!
notes.content:
■[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ce850287670cb91fec35e98f64ba3a9ec0a7468d.jpg[/img]
On February 28, 2023, post-maintenance, the Blessings of Fire and Ice Gacha will be released!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 29, 11:59 pm (PT)

[b]New Unit
Heavenly Knight Melza (Voice: Chiwa Saito)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/e52d781c03fb87afce4f58b1ff2cb4ee91eb1757.png[/img]

[b]New Ark
Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice (SSR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/a2758dd362132840516861a506973d560b309711.png[/img]

Ark Trait (Ark Lv10)
When HP is 50% or more, STR+35%.
When HP is less than 50%, DEF/ MND +25%.
When taking lethal damage, survive and recover 50% HP (once per wave).
Battle Start: Autocast Fire Wall II and Ice Wall II on unit only.

[b]100% Ark Ether Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6daa9fb77c557f259f8c35e56d7f5567964caba2.png[/img]

[b]Event The White Knight Returns Released![/b]
■[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/70e74e8728163fe73cc31b9343bc4bba38324e19.jpg[/img]
This event will be held on the exclusive event map Continent of Mordana.

Explore Melza’s backstory in more depth while also taking on challenges from the Monster Collector’s Manor.
Additionally, from part 2 of the event, new story, an extra challenge, and a superboss will also appear!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
▼Summary
Once, there was a trio who set out to save the world by slaying the God of Ruin.
However, after Vaughn and Seilios were defeated by the overwhelming power of Degrogue, one of the Four Lords of Ruin,
they vanished.
Then, White Knight Melza, engulfed in despair, became a servant of the God of Ruin.
As Soul Reaper Melza, she continues to reap even the smallest buds of hope from humanity to this day…
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


[b]Daily Free Blessings of Fire and Ice Gacha Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2bba7ceebfc47c9e04cb886da5fd5554c4861622.jpg[/img]
This is a once daily one-spin gacha that you can spin for free, for a total of 17 free spins.

The new unit Heavenly Knight Melza and the new ark Gallant Fire, Imperial Ice are on rate-up, so don’t forget to spin the gacha every day!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

[b]Cookie Hunters[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ac09cd9c98d3c2eb9a49e633f63254fda2b3dd39.jpg[/img]
This is a once-daily quest that only male units can take on.
Completing this quest will get you Godrelic Prism Shards and tons of Romantic Pokkle Cookies, so don’t forget to take it on every day!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]Pokkle Cookie Trading Space[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/d1087a0149148120bdc213f8bcfc72a54d8c5f44.jpg[/img]
Trade in the Romantic Pokkle Cookies that you’ve collected for valuable items!
Cookies can be exchanged for items such as a ★Prism Exchange Ticket, which can be used to get a unit prism for a male unit, and each type of radiance.

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 22, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]White Day Login Bonus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/7f5777926b2775e6d3037b20d146b3cb6d26e180.png[/img]
This login bonus gives Pokkle Cookies and Zekus Stamp!

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]White Day Step-Up Gacha Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/34653563a5aa0d2a1d04f8c7e32b461856fcd79f.png[/img]
This gacha is a step-up gacha that advances to the next step each time you spin the gacha.
You can pull up to the second lap only once.

[Gacha Points]
1.All steps can be spun with crystals!
2.Only male units appear!
These include Descent of Heroes Festival exclusive units!
*Some units will not appear.
3.Lap 2, Step 5 features a ★Unit Exchange Ticket that can be exchanged for one male unit!

*The unit Lougseus, God of Ruin’s gender is listed as unknown, and is therefore not a male unit; however, this unit will appear in this gacha.
This also applies to the ★Unit Exchange Ticket.
*Be sure to check the trading space lineup in advance.

[Period]
Feb 28, post-maintenance – Mar 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]Premium LC Pass Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/28ed312fc84ff2c1c104cccc755c590f7e94d621.jpg[/img]
We’ve added a new LC pass (subscription feature)!
The premium LC pass is a monthly subscription service that gives you the following perks for a modest price from the day you buy it.

You can get up to 4000 Crystals every month, so don’t miss out!

 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

notes.title: Valentine Event Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/b53726096bcd2258a862099210b29cdfce710d3b.jpg[/img]
On February 9, 2023, post-maintenance, the Valentine event will be released!


[b]■ Valentine Challenge[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/c80665ac37c59d7c619cb6c4d9d8c075434063dc.png[/img]
The Valentine Challenge consists of nine simple missions that appear on the Home screen.
Rewards include the new LR ark Sweet Granzelian Rock and a stamp.

[b]Sweet Granzelian Rock (LR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/18f179717f2eb7d90eb8110bba3e5abb6cae2da7.png[/img]
[b]▼Ark Trait (Ark Lv 10)[/b]
Each wave, gradually boost damage dealt and taken (for each, max +50%).
Blind/ Silence resistance +1.
When unit is buffed, Special damage dealt +50%.

[b]100% Ark Ether Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/3ea6f675024cc39c2b9e8dd60cad4c402b58b701.png[/img]

[Period]
Feb 9, post-maintenance – Feb 21, 10:59 pm (PT)


[b]■ Chocolate Hunters[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/a57770c4a6bcee2681f3d8b71d41dc5c1c4f8cff.jpg[/img]
This is a once-daily quest that only female units can take on.
Completing this quest will get you prism soul shards and tons of Pokkle Chocolates, so don’t forget to take it on every day!

[Period]
Feb 9, post-maintenance – Feb 21, 10:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]■ Pokkle Chocolate Trading Space[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/83257a01f58454aacbeae13de27c4320ccb1c8b4.jpg[/img]
Trade the Pokkle Chocolates that you collect for valuable items! Chocolates can be exchanged for items such as a ★Prism Exchange Ticket, which can be used to get a unit prism for a female unit, as well as a ★Valentine Letter Trade Ticket.

Additionally, you can also get the redux LR ark Maidens’ Lovely Banquet!

[b]Maidens’ Lovely Banquet (LR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/edf2353884a26b957f80be2bd87e22d51ed90ac8.png[/img]
[b]▼Ark Trait (Ark Lv 10)[/b]
Healing magic casting speed +30%.
When buffed by support magic from other female units, become more easily targeted and gain DEF +25%.
While other female units are alive, MP regen to self (2 MP per tick) and +10% healing magic power for each other female unit.
 

[Period]
Feb 9, post-maintenance – Feb 27, 10:59 pm (PT)
 

[b]■ Valentine Letter Trading Space[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1ee9ea314f720fe6feb9d493bb3c03aa467c9408.jpg[/img]
Get ★Valentine Letter Trade Tickets from the Pokkle Chocolate Trading Space and Login Bonus, and trade them for letters from each female unit.
Once you’ve gotten a letter, you can read it from the Important tab on the Inventory screen!

During this event period, you can get a maximum of three ★Valentine Letter Trade Tickets.

[Period]
Feb 14, 12:00 am (PT) – Feb 27, 10:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]■ Valentine Login Bonus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ad7bed484f27e9cce0c6888827c90c707a508f7c.png[/img]
A login bonus will be released that includes Pokkle Chocolates and ★Valentine Letter Trade Tickets!

[Period]
Feb 9, post-maintenance – Feb 21, 10:59 pm (PT)


[b]■Valentine Step-Up Gacha Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6cb7bf49a63b0041d932f516906e620649b23c26.png[/img]
This gacha is a step-up gacha that advances to the next step each time you spin the gacha.
You can pull up to the second lap only once.

[Gacha Points]
１. All steps can be spun with free crystals!
２. Only female units will appear!
　　Limited-time units and Descent of Heroes Festival-exclusive units are also available!
　　*Some units may not appear. For details, please check [Probability] in advance.
３. On lap 2, step 5, you’ll get a ★Unit Exchange Ticket that can be exchanged for a female unit!

*Be sure to check the Trading Space lineup in advance.

[Period]
Feb 9, post-maintenance – Feb 21, 10:59 pm (PT)


 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

notes.title: Lagrobos the Wise and Ancient Fairyland Mamanap Join Last Cloudia!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/0cb1e7f93abc39d238f97afec454308208288238.jpg[/img]
On September 30, 2022, post-maintenance, the Descent of Heroes Festival and Step-Up Descent of Heroes Festival will be released!

[b]New Unit
Lagrobos the Wise (Voice: Akio Nojima)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/59b58588cd584735e23fe74851f1282139c691d7.png[/img]

[b]New Ark
Ancient Fairyland Mamanap (SSR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/b1f7334da009179854dd06db89b8d76bb4d0f049.png[/img]
Ark Trait (Ark Lv 10):
Staff and Robe Equipped: INT/ MND +15%.
Battle Start: Autocast Recast and Regeneration.
When using nonstacking magic, damage +20%/ damage cap +1500.

[b]100% Ark Ether Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/7fb5bf500638fecc04d85640cfbb057c9aa76f58.png[/img]


[b]Event Guardian of the Northland Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ff0cacd65ee9c88d7a11b347792222e6934cd28f.jpg[/img]

This is a collaborative event between all users to repel the two Advocates of God attacking the limited-time event map, Continent of Lanzelia.

You can earn a variety of amazing rewards depending on how many times you repel the Advocates of God and how many honor points you earn.
Additionally, the limited-time event map also features special training quests!

------------------------------------------------------------
▼Summary
In the time just before the Great War of Ruin broke out,
Granzelia was subjected to the atrocities of the Army of Ruin.
In the northern lands of Lanzelia,
a single wandering sorcerer held the power to stand
in opposition to the Army of Ruin.
------------------------------------------------------------

[b]■ 3.5 Year Anniversary Countdown Promo Released[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/ea8440cb1b97ac6812b39e6b7a605a358f5d9b50.png[/img]
[Period]
Sep 30, post-maintenance – Oct 12, 11:59 pm (PT)

 

[b]3.5 Year Anniversary Ticket Stock Gacha Released![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/faa3aa53e591355bd1887826eb27651bd5861118.jpg[/img]

On October 13, 2022, post-maintenance, the 3.5 Year Anniversary Hero Pick-up Ticket Stock Gacha will be released!
Here’s how to spin this gacha:

１. Collect ★3.5 Year Stock Tickets from the 3.5 Year Anniversary Ticket Stock Gacha Login Bonus that will be released from Sep 22, post-maintenance.

２. Use the ★3.5 Year Stock Tickets you’ve collected to spin the 3.5 Year Anniversary Hero Pick-up Ticket Stock Gacha that will be released from Oct 13, post-maintenance.

Log in every day to collect as many tickets as you can!


[b]LC Pass Released[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/c6a43a7ef5d6d992bfc6916f39714c616493207d.jpg[/img]
The LC pass is a subscription service that gives you a month of perks for a low price from the day you buy it.
Don’t miss out on this chance to easily train your units!

 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

notes.title: NieR:Automata Collaboration Event Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2d9bce9f1b9c2d9614a341d5ba208e4237464434.png[/img]
Thank you for playing Last Cloudia.

On August 26, 2021, after maintenance, a collaboration event with the tremendously popular action RPG NieR:Automata will be released!

[b]Period[/b]
August 26, 2021 post-maintenance -
September 15, 11:59 pm (PT)

[url=https://prod-notice.world-en.aidis-games.com/notice/2021/notice/co04/notice_en_20210825_2_event_aGIDq6rl.html]To detail page[/url]

[previewyoutube=MMAcHMWkZw0;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]★Special Comment★[/h3]
We've also received a special message from Yoko Taro, director of NieR:Automata.
Check out this wild video below!

[previewyoutube=EvYmNetg3V4;full][/previewyoutube]


[url=https://prod-notice.world-en.aidis-games.com/notice/2021/notice/co04/notice_en_20210826_2_event_XGlViQqU.html][h3]Event Granzelia Descent Released![/h3][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/690f3d576fda7bf1f72787737e6a3a998cf57e3a.png[/img]

The event Granzelia Descent features a variety of quests, including time trials that make use of Last Cloudia’s new 3-party battle feature. As well as recreating the boss battle 2B and the others had with Simone, there is also a special fishing event to enjoy. Players can get units and arks, as well as 11 pieces of collab equipment and a ton of gacha tickets.
